tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /mgon po bcu bdun ma'i bskang ba dgra bgegs srog gcod bzhugs// swasti/ gyi ljang lugs kyi mgon po'i bskang ba bya tshul ni/ gtor ma gru gsum che ba gcig la de 'dra chung ba bcu drug gis bskor ba la mar dang sha khrag gi rgyan ci mdzes dang / 'byor na mda' dar sngon po btsugs/ mchod pa dang chang phud spyi 'gre bshams/ bdag bskyed dang gtor bsngo rdzogs nas/ gu gul gsur chen gyi dud pa sbyar/ rnga rol dang bcas pas/ hūm̐ ya/ e dbyings dur khrod 'bar ba'i klong dkyil nas/ /ma hā kā la gshin rje pho mo'i tshogs/ /sngon gyi thugs dam dam tshig rjes dgongs la/ /'dir gshegs pad nyi zhing chen gdan la bzhugs/ /oṃ shrī ma hā kā la ya ya ma rā dza sa pa ri wā ra badzra sa mā dzaḥ padma surya bai ta li tiṣṭhantu/ hūm̐ ya/ gru gsum mthing dbus mtshon 'khor rtsibs brgyad steng / /ma hā kā la mthing nag rngams pa'i sku/ /phyogs mtshams brgyad du bka' nyan gshin rje'i tshogs/ /shar phyogs ya ba ti dang pho nya mo/ /lho phyogs chos kyi rgyal po mche ba mo/ /nub phyogs tel pa dang ni be con ma/ /byang phyogs glang mgo can dang lcags kyu ma/ /byang shar ral pa tshar dgu dus mtshan ma/ /nub byang dmigs pa dang ni zhags pa ma/ /lho nub gshin rje phya sangs lu gu brgyud/ /shar lhor gshin rje mig dmar 'bebs ma ste/ /gtso 'khor kun kyang mthing nag drag po'i chas/ /gri gug thod 'dzin sde brgyad tshogs dang bcas/ /ye shes me dpung dbus bzhugs 'khor bcas la/ /drug ldan rten dang mchod gtor rgya mtsho'i tshogs/ /ting 'dzin sngags dang phyag rgyas byin brlabs nas/ /dang ba'i sems kyis 'bul lo brtse bas bzhes/ /bstan dang bstan 'dzin dar zhing 'jig rten bde/ /khyad par bdag cag yon mchod 'khor bcas kyi/ /las nyon sdig sgrib nyer 'tshe kun zhi nas/ /legs tshogs rgyas shing khams gsum dbang du bsdus/ /zhing bcu tshang ba'i dgra bgegs thams cad dang /

/khyad par bdag cag dpon slob 'khor bcas kyi/ /dam chos sgrub la bar du gcod pa yi/ /phyi nang gsang ba'i dgra bgegs log 'dren kun/ /lo zla ma 'gyangs myur du tshar bcad nas/ /sha khrag rus pa tshogs kyi 'khor lor rol/ /rnam shes dag pa chos kyi dbyings su drongs/ /log 'dren mi dang mi min dpung bcas kun/ /thal ba'i rdul du rlog pa'i phrin las mdzod/ /bdag cag dpon slob 'khor dang bcas pa la/ /deng nas bzung ste byang chub snying po'i bar/ /ma hā kā la ma gshin dregs pa'i tshogs/ /mi 'bral lus dang grib bzhin 'grogs nas kyang / /srung skyob sba ba'i phrin las kun bsgrubs nas/ /he ru ka dpal go 'phang myur thob mdzod/ /hūm̐ ya/ dpal ldan mgon po nag po ni/ /gri gug thod 'dzin dur khrod brgyan/ /pad nyi zhing chen bsnol steng bzhugs/ /bstan srung chen po khyod la bstod/ /srid pa'i ma mo chen mo brgyad/ /rab 'jigs rgyan dang cha lugs 'chang / /dal yams bstan dgra'i dpung la 'debs/ /ma mo'i gtso mo brgyad la bstod/ /'jigs rungs las kyi gshin rje brgyad/ /gtum rngams drag shul mthu stobs kyis/ /bstan pa'i dgra bo'i srog dbugs len/ /las kyi gshed po brgyad la bstod/ /mgon po 'khor los dam rdzas bzhes/ /dza gad dzam bu ti ba bzhes/ /sha khrag dmar gyi mchod gtor bzhes/ /sman raka phud kyi mchod pa bzhes/ /bdag cag 'khor bcas srung zhing skyongs/ /bstan la gnod byed rdul du rlog /rtsa brgyud bla ma'i bka' bsgo bzhin/ /bcol pa'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod/ /ces brjod la mchod gtor gtsang sar bskyal/ rjes chog spyi 'gre bzhin bya'o/ /zhes pa 'di yang skyo mda' sprul sku 'jam dbyangs bstan 'dzin bzang po'i zhal 'don du sa skya pa kun blos sa yos smin drug zla ba'i mar ngo'i gza' tshes dge bar mgyogs par sbyar ba dge zhing / rtsa yig pa ni gzhu lung pa'o//
